```{r}
library(tibble)
sales <- tribble(
    ~prod, ~`2024`, ~`2025`, ~`2026`,
    "A", 10, 20, 30,
    "B", 33, 22, 11,
    "C", 15, 25, 35
)
sales
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
sales |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = -prod, names_to = "year", values_to = "sales") |> 
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = year, y = sales, color = prod)) +
    geom_point(size = 10) +
    geom_line()
```
